data.name: WARNING
data.data: Usually the color red. These lights usually indicate a potentially serious problem that should be checked by a certified mechanic. There is also a chance that these lights could also indicate a need to get the vehicle serviced.

data.name: ADVISORY
data.data: Usually yellowish or amber in color. These lights generally indicate that a part or component of the vehicle needs to be services or repaired. If these or any light starts flashing, contact a mechanic

data.name: INFORMATION
data.data: These lights could be either Green or Blue. These are less series lights that are mostly used to let the driver know that a system in the vehicle is active and operational
